title: boolean flag ext.popunder=1 hint (no adtype string), location.replace redirect script

source.name: ortbtools Core pop-family ext-hint recognition contract (packages/core/non-iab-formats.js FLAG_HINT_KEYS, packages/core/rules/pop-request/index.js, packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js) layered on IAB OpenRTB 2.x Imp/ext extensibility — the product's own documented, in-repo mechanism for pop signalling by a truthy flag key, not a named vendor's wire format
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: Distinct mechanism from the adtype-string-hint siblings: FLAG_HINT_KEYS is a separate boolean-presence signal (ext.popunder=1) rather than a string value in ext.adtype.

modifications: All IDs, domains, prices and timestamps independently authored.
device.ip uses TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; user.id is a clearly synthetic string.
advertiser.example.test / tracking.example.test / publisher.example.test are reserved .test hosts; no live host, tracker or subscriber identifier.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; every identifier is a synthetic-fixture string; every URL uses a reserved .test hostname.

pairApplicability.note: A genuine oRTB auction pair: the response bid references the offered impression, ids match, and the ext hint is a Core-recognized, non-vendor-attributed extension convention, not a proprietary wire wrapper.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/119.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

specNotes: packages/core/non-iab-formats.js FLAG_HINT_KEYS recognizes a truthy imp.ext.popunder value as a pop hint independent of any ext.adtype string — 'imp.ext.popunder = 1 instead of imp.ext.adtype = "popunder"' per the file's own header comment. imp.non_standard_format (INFO) fires with params.format='popunder' at path imp[0].ext.popunder.

`location.replace(URL)` is explicitly named in admLooksLikePop's regex (location.(href|replace|assign)) and in packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js's header comment ('location.href = URL' redirect family) as an accepted pop adm shape.

packages/core/crosscheck.js's pop-landing rule extracts the redirect destination from inside the location.replace(...) call (extractPopLandingHost's 'inside the redirect call sites' branch) and must match bid.adomain.
Browser preview must not open a real popup or dispatch tracking.
notes: Plain `iab` dialect, deliberately not the `ext-rtb` vendor dialect used by the sibling EXADS/Kadam/PPCmate/Adon3 pop cases.

preview.limitation: pop script has no visual body

knownGap.note: The redirect-script pop is detected and an inert destination note is built, but it does not reach the measured on-screen identity: the caption is appended beside a zero-footprint iframe and the harness still reads no visible marker. The sandbox refusal itself is correct and unchanged.
